en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a street-front building complex with leafless trees and several people standing in an open square in front. The central three‑story building bears large painted advertisements and signage in German, including the beer brand "Feldschlösschen," as well as references to a restaurant, skittle alley, billiard and social rooms. On the right is a longer, more formal building with arched windows and a small tower-like end pavilion. The architecture and clothing suggest an early‑20th‑century Central European town scene.
